changes_from_v1: execution window and decision-freshness checks are now coded in the wrapper, not only declared
daily-loss and drawdown limits are now coded in the wrapper with a pause/resume record
rung 1 of the ladder requires bill's wrapper review items to be closed; a 10-session match is necessary, not sufficient (bill, 2026-11-07 01:52)
scope: the KR daily loop on 069500 (KODEX 200) only; paper mode by default; live only after the owner writes DOBBY_LIVE=1 in the channel

capital.account: owner's Toss KR account cash plus the daily 10,000 won refill
capital.instrument: 069500 only; no other instrument is traded by this loop
capital.position: either all cash or all-in 069500 (integer shares affordable with fee); no leverage, no short, no derivatives

signal.rule: EMA ribbon 8 > 21 > 50 > 200 on adjusted closes from the series origin 2002-10-14 (rule core 09d0cf42 rejects any other start): weight 1 when fully stacked, else 0
signal.decision_time: 15:35 KST on each trading session, only on a completed daily bar (fetched after 15:31); the wrapper refuses to decide before 15:31:00 and records too_early
signal.execution: next trading session inside 09:00:30..09:10:00 KST only (outside the window: execution_skip, no order); the pending decision must come from the most recent trading session: if a weekday between the decision day and today has a traded daily candle, the decision is stale and skipped (execution_skip stale decision); market buy of the affordable integer quantity when weight 1 and not held; market sell of the whole holding when weight 0 and held; nothing otherwise
signal.evidence: retrospective ledger 2014-12-30..2026-11-05: +48,095,602 won (99.5% from 2025-2026), max drawdown -14,865,836, exposure 39%, TWR +200.9% (always-long +243.4%), unit drawdown -24.5% (always-long -42.9%); plateau and delay/cost stress passed on the same history; one same-data history, not a forward guarantee

limits.daily_loss: coded: if the account value at the 15:35 decision is below 97% of the previous decision's value, no new buy is placed (rule weight 1 with no holding becomes 0); an existing holding follows the rule; the decision row records w_rule, w and limits
limits.drawdown: coded: if the account value is below 85% of the peak decision value in the ledger, the weight becomes 0 (flatten at the next open) and a pause row is written; while paused the loop records paused_skip at 15:35 and skips any non-flatten execution; only the owner resumes with dobby_kr.py resume
kill_switch: stale data: no complete bar by 15:40 or no orderbook at execution -> no order, alert
order anomaly: rejected, cancelled or partial fill not resolved within 90 s -> pause the loop, alert (live mode only; not yet coded as an automatic pause)
rule breach: any order outside 09:00:30..09:10 KST or on an instrument other than 069500 -> freeze the loop until the owner restarts it (the window is coded; the instrument is fixed in code)
limits.broker_side: where Toss allows, set an account-level daily order cap for 069500 equal to the loop's size; this is a wall, the loop's checks are only rules

records.ledger: runs/dobby_kr_ledger.jsonl append-only: loop_start, decision (EMAs, trend, w_rule, w, limits, value_prev, value_peak), execution (ask/bid, quantity, fee), execution_skip with reason, too_early, paused_skip, pause, resume, revision, error
records.channel: one line per decision and per execution in #bigmoney; alerts (limits, stale decision, pause) immediately
records.weekly: every Sunday 18:00 KST: paper/live results vs the rule core applied to the stored bars for the same sessions (consistency check), posted to the channel

promotion_ladder.name: paper
promotion_ladder.condition_to_advance: 10 trading sessions logged with every decision matching the rule core applied to the stored bars (zero mismatches) AND bill's wrapper review items closed (execution window, decision freshness, limits in code, and anything else found); the 10-session match is necessary, not sufficient

promotion_ladder.name: live
promotion_ladder.condition: owner writes DOBBY_LIVE=1 in the channel after rung 1 evidence is posted
promotion_ladder.capital: the account as is (small); no size ramp needed

promotion_ladder.name: review
promotion_ladder.condition: every Sunday; demote to paper on any kill-switch trigger or a rule-code change until the change is reviewed

change_control: the rule, its parameters and the limits change only by a new spec with hashes reviewed by bill; no parameter change after seeing live results without a written spec
not_covered: the research council axes (T, Fly, Jev) until they pass their own gates

KRX holiday calendar: a holiday between the decision and the execution is inferred only from the provider's daily candles (no candle on the weekday = not a session); a provider gap would be misread as a holiday
deposits: the paper value does not include the daily 10,000 won refill, so the paper limits are stricter than the live account
